headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 22, 2026**
article:
The Houston Astros secured a 4-2 victory over the Chicago Cubs, with Christian Vázquez leading the offense and Spencer Arrighetti pitching a strong 5.0 innings. The Cleveland Guardians shut down the Philadelphia Phillies in a 1-0 win, with Gavin Williams pitching 8.0 innings of scoreless baseball and Kyle Manzardo leading the Guardians' offense with a solo home run. The Tampa Bay Rays took down the New York Yankees 4-2, with Austin Wells leading the offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Lourdes Gurriel Jr. (left hamstring strain) and Carter Baumler (right intercostal strain), who have been placed on the injured list by the Arizona Diamondbacks and Texas Rangers, respectively. Jordan Hicks (right lat strain) has been placed on the injured list by the Chicago White Sox, while Mickey Moniak (right ankle tendonitis), Jung Hoo Lee (mid-back strain), Burch Smith (right shoulder inflammation), Ke'Bryan Hayes (lumbar bulging disc), and Yoán Moncada (right knee inflammation) have been placed on the injured list by the Colorado Rockies, San Francisco Giants, Detroit Tigers, Cincinnati Reds, and Los Angeles Angels, respectively.

The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for future considerations, while the Cincinnati Reds traded RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley. The Tampa Bay Rays traded LHP Joe Rock to the Chicago White Sox for 3B Oliver Dunn, and the Toronto Blue Jays traded LHP Eric Lauer to the Los Angeles Dodgers for cash.

top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 1-0 win over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Gavin Williams pitching 8.0 innings of scoreless baseball, striking out 11 batters and allowing just 4 hits. Kyle Manzardo led the Guardians' offense with a solo home run.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down Yankees 4-2**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a 4-2 victory over the New York Yankees, with Austin Wells leading the offense with a home run and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Blue Jays in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays defeated the Pittsburgh Pirates 6-2, securing a win in their matchup. Kevin Gausman earned the win for the Blue Jays, while Louis Varland secured the save.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Cruise Past Reds 8-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Cincinnati Reds, securing an 8-1 victory. Iván Herrera, Alec Burleson, Jordan Walker, Bryan Torres, Victor Scott II, and Nathaniel Lowe all contributed to the Cardinals' strong performance.

top_news.title: **Astros Shut Out Cubs 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured a dominant 3-0 victory over the Chicago Cubs, marking a strong performance for the Astros. Impact players on the day included Christian Walker and Kai-Wei Teng.

top_news.title: **Gurriel Jr. Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Arizona Diamondbacks left fielder Lourdes Gurriel Jr. has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain.

top_news.title: **Phillies Make Roster Move**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies made a trade on May 22, 2026, sending RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies in exchange for Future Considerations and International Bonus Pool Money.
